text: Hurrah for riches!” “For riches!” echoed Mrs. Munt, having, as it were, at last secured her nut. For riches. Money for ever!” “So am I, and so, I am afraid, are most of my acquaintances at Swanage, but I am surprised that you agree with us.” “Thank you so much, Aunt Juley. While I have talked theories, you have done the flowers.” “Not at all, dear. I wish you would let me help you in more important things.” “Well, would you be very kind?
